children: Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL, Financials), the computer and enterprise infrastructure company, rose about 11% Friday as investors returned to one of the most obvious hardware beneficiaries of the AI investment binge.
The move comes after a bullish beginning out of RBC Capital Markets, which rated Dell Outperform with a $640 price target.Dell's backlog is the bigger number.
Our fiscal second quarter ended with roughly $95 billion of AI server orders in backlog, even after booking some $132 billion in orders over the past 12 months.
RBC thinks the market is still supply constrained and not demand limited and that the availability of memory is a critical hurdle.
That might leave Dell's backlog elevated through fiscal 2027 and provide investors with improved insight into 2028. Demand is spreading outside AI servers too.

Companies are moving away from legacy servers and PCs, and the use of agentic AI is driving demand for CPUs to run orchestration software. Some of the larger customers are now engaging into three- to five-year contracts to lock in supplies.

HPE and HP also surged Friday, suggesting the move is more than just one firm. Dell's next test: Execution. For investors. The backlog is already huge. What counts is how soon the corporation can turn it into sales, cash flow and durable margins.

title: Dell, HPE and HP Surge as AI Demand Fuels Hardware Boom
